caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a painted sculpture of a nude female figure. The figure stands upright on a plain, light beige background. She has long hair that is styled back and partially drapes over her shoulders. Her right arm is bent at the elbow, with her hand raised and fingers forming a gesture, while her left hand holds a large, scalloped shell or fabric that cascades from her waist to her feet. The sculpture is predominantly painted in various shades of brown, with darker brown and black lines defining the contours and features of the body and face. The shell or fabric has hues of green, blue, and muted red, with darker shading to suggest folds and depth. The overall coloring of the sculpture is weathered, showing patches where paint has worn away, revealing lighter base material underneath. There are no additional objects or background elements in the composition.
title: Draped Figure
